title: Indigo Breeze | KEY.co
description_expanded: This was the best beach house for our family. We had 8 adults with 4 children ages3-6 and a 3 month old. The carriage house was good for the new baby and parents. The bunk room was good for the others. The pool was awesome ! Kids and adults loved it . Game room provided some indoor activity as well. Kitchen was well stocked and bedrooms were comfortable and well supplied w towels. The doors to the pool had an alarm which was good with small children, albeit, the one in the carriage house was extremely loud. There was a good supply of beach chairs, umbrellas, toys, etc which was great. The golf cart is a lifesaver with small children. We have already rebooked this home for next year! Every home is well equipped with linens on each bed, as well as an extra set for any sleeper sofas that may be in the home. Each bathroom is stocked appropriately with bath towels, hand towels, wash cloths, and bath mats to accommodate the sleeping capacity of the home. There are starter sets of soap, detergent, dish soap, and toilet paper there for your convenience. Kitchens are each stocked with enough dishes, serving pieces, glassware, and all the other kitchen necessities to prepare meals during the guests stay. We provide a starter set of laundry detergent for our guests to use when they arrive.
